# ARC generator review — `review-9432a0bfd332a6c9`

## `20014c9d3729` — prototype

The production generator (version 4.0.0, SHA-256
`3ddb8251733e4dcb9d0722c636154b6ed01a8eed95df9403852c798e2e810c1f`) was
left unchanged. I added a complete native family with canonical
`per_color_largest` and alternate `min_winner_threshold` settings. The alternate
computes every color's winner size, relays their input-dependent minimum, then
uses it to filter all objects. A maximum-threshold Racket counterfactual provides
the protected causal witness.

The family supports 2–6 demos and 1–4 queries, matched deterministic inputs,
prefix stability, four distinct queries and substantive 30x30 stress. Its bounded
self-audit covered seeds 0/17/97 and demo counts 2/3/6 for both settings: 18
reports, 61 protected-Racket evaluations and no surviving declared shortcut.
Authoring preflight, causal replay, public projection/privacy checks and 39 focused
tests passed.

## `b7564fb4b95d` — repaired + native family

The original generator omitted `RULE_HASH`, ignored all controls, accepted invalid
scalar types and allowed degenerate impostors through `self_check`. I replaced that
contract with version 2.0.0 (SHA-256
`e042618b899fa67ad96da1f74a8621e67d18c12d3e3870a829aaed278d3edaa7`), pinned
rule hash `dfa4e91b5010`, exact `grid_h/grid_w/n_frames/command_code` controls,
strict validation, structural parsing and preserved original-label replay.
Canonical-scale ordinary frames are retained; exact 30x30/three-frame stress is
also supported. Final lint, self-check and defect lint passed. The override checker
accepted 5,220/5,220 draws over 58 cases and three bands with zero findings.

The native family preserves canonical `command_only` and adds
`command_then_reflect`: command rotation produces an intermediate orientation that
is then reflected before stamping. A reflect-then-command Racket program is the
wrong-order causal counterfactual. It has the same count/query guarantees as the
first family. Its bounded audit also produced 18 reports and 61 protected-Racket
labels with no surviving declared shortcut; current-source preflight, causal
replay, public projection/privacy and 39 focused tests passed.

## Scope and limits

previous_catalog_record.summary: Cell (0, 0) is the selector color and (0, w-1) is the command color. Elsewhere: a source shape in the selector color plus one or more rectangular hollow frames in other distinct colors. Rule selects the largest selector-colored blob, transforms it by the command code, then stamps the transformed shape inside each frame (centered), using each frame's color. Output drops the selector/command markers and source shape.

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The normalized command-oriented source cell set produced from the selected source and command marker.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Select the largest selector-colored source, normalize it, and apply the input command rotation.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Horizontally reflect that exact oriented template and center-stamp it inside every detected frame.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Quarter-turn rotation and horizontal reflection do not commute, so step B must consume the orientation produced by step A; reflecting before the command changes the stamp.

parametric_work.summary: Canonical command transform plus command-oriented-shape reflection; repaired exact base controls, 2–6 demos, four queries, 30x30 stress, protected Racket audit and causal replay.

target_report.summary: Repaired the production generator contract and added a complete command-then-reflect native family with protected wrong-order evidence.
